content.text:
## Root cause

**Primary — tabs scroll out of view (looks like “no navigation”):**  
`.app-shell` uses `overflow: hidden`. That blocks `position: sticky` on descendants, so `.admin-tabs` did **not** stay pinned while `.app-main` scrolls. On desktop (two-column list + form), scrolling into the category form pushes the tab bar off-screen. Users stay on the default **Categories** panel and assume Tasks/Rewards/Punishments are missing.

**Secondary — “only categories works” (already fixed earlier):**  
Tasks failed when `draft.categoryId` stayed `''` while the select showed the first category. `resolvedCategoryId` on submit/validation fixes that; still present in `Admin.tsx`.

Tab logic in `Admin.tsx` was correct (`tab` state + conditional panels). Layout does not hide tabs; bottom nav does not cover them.

## Fix applied

1. **`src/index.css`**
   - `.app-shell--admin-full { overflow: visible; }` so sticky works inside `.app-main`
   - New `.admin-chrome` — sticky header + tab bar (`top: 0`, `z-index: 30`, solid background + shadow)
   - `.admin-tabs` — horizontal scroll only (sticky moved to chrome wrapper)

2. **`src/pages/Admin.tsx`**
   - Wrap page header + tab nav in `.admin-chrome`
   - Tablist/tabpanel ARIA (`role="tablist"`, `aria-controls`, etc.)

## Verified unchanged

| Item | Status |
|------|--------|
| `resolvedCategoryId` for Tasks submit/validation | Still in `TaskAdmin` |
| `app-shell--admin-full` full-width admin | Still in `Layout.tsx` + CSS |
| All 5 tabs switch panels | `categories` / `tasks` / `rewards` / `punishments` / `users` |
| Create handlers | `addCategory`, `addTask`, `addReward`, `addPunishmentTemplate` |

## Files changed

- `src/index.css`
- `src/pages/Admin.tsx`

After refresh, the bar **Categories | Tasks | Rewards | Punishments | Users** should stay visible at the top of the admin scroll area while you scroll the forms below.
